# libs/domain/gatherings

Framework-agnostic business logic for Gatherings (PRD §13.4): the
generalized Gathering type hierarchy ("Everything Is A Gathering",
Blueprint §12.4/§2.4 of the PRD), recurrence-series handling, attendance-
completeness evaluation.

Depends only on `@ecclesia/contracts`.

**Status:** registered as a real Nx project (Sprint 0 Milestone 2), building and testing cleanly. Real domain logic lands in the Gatherings domain-modeling milestone.
